audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart sides disagreed with content win[] and the packet on rows 1-6 (full read Talon,Talon,Talon,Talon,Skill,Skill,Skill vs packet Talon,Skill,Skill,Skill,Talon,Talon,Viktor).
audit.why: Content win[] matches the packet; full sides were template leftovers.
audit.corrected: Six side-alone edits with rewritten whys (win[] already correct, so paired edits would be no-ops).

audit.why: Spikes right: his 3-5 combo window, his 6 (Shadow Assault 100s CD + wall-hop roams), Viktor takeover at 2+ items. Restated in fixed whys.

audit.whatIsWrong: "Shadow Assassin" for Talon's R in whys[4] and spikes[1] (really Shadow Assault); "Death Ray" for Viktor's E in five content fields (Riot text: Hextech Ray).
audit.why: Packet suspectNames plus kit text confirm both. 'Siphon Power's' suspect is a false positive — correct possessive of the real Q name.
audit.corrected: Both names fixed everywhere they appear.

audit.why: Rake 9s rank 1, his R 100s, Viktor W 17s.
dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were verbatim tradeGood/tradeBad under unrelated titles.
audit.corrected: Rewritten to match their titles with kit-grounded content.

edits.before: Talon
edits.after: Skill

edits.before: E online: the laser farms AND pokes in one cast. Aim it through minions into his chest on every wave contact.
edits.after: E online farms and pokes at range — his level-2 threat is real, but spacing keeps this trade a coin flip.

edits.before: Talon
edits.after: Skill

edits.before: Full kit: W zones his aggression and the E-Q-auto trade pattern is fully armed. Stack your first augment quietly.
edits.after: His level-3 combo is online, but your W peels the E-hop — Gravity Field keeps the all-in a skill check, not a sentence.

edits.before: Talon
edits.after: Skill

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — laser every wave contact and bank Manaflow. Each augment makes the same spells quietly crueler.
edits.after: Lost Chapter timing — laser his step-ups and bank Manaflow; your poke and cautious farm blunt his kill threat to even.

edits.before: Skill
edits.after: Talon

edits.before: Chaos Storm online — your all-in answer and teamfight entry. In lane it's the kill: W-E-R on anyone who oversteps.
edits.after: His Shadow Assault plus wall-hop roams beat your 6: Chaos Storm answers a fight, not his stealth — hold W to live.

edits.before: Skill
edits.after: Talon

edits.before: Luden's spike: the laser chunks a third bar and the storm executes the remainder. Force extended rotations.
edits.after: His one-item burst and mobility still out-tempo Luden's — respect the one-shot until your second item lands.

edits.before: Skill
edits.after: Viktor

edits.before: Evolved late-game Viktor is a zone the enemy can't enter: W the choke, E the clump, and steer R through the retreat.
edits.after: Two items on, evolved Viktor is a zone Talon can't enter: W the choke, E the clump, and steer R through the retreat.

edits.before: - Talon Rake: matchup-defining — The boomerang return is most of his lane damage — stand off the return line. Check it before every step-up. - W Gravity Field is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Rake (W) is 9s at rank 1 and the return is most of his lane damage — stand off the return line; the window after it whiffs is your trade. - His R is 100s at 6. - Your W is 17s early: it is the lifeline, chip damage never gets it.

edits.before: E through the wave into his chest, Q-shield the response, empowered-auto, and walk — a full trade where his answer hit a shield.
edits.after: Keep the minion line between you — his Q leap is 575 range and E-hop needs a wall, so a screened laser pokes with no answer back.

edits.before: Casting E at melee-adjacent range against a loaded engage — Viktor's cast times are an assassin's favorite metronome.
edits.after: Half HP is one full rotation: E-in, Q crit, Rake return and the bleed finish — reset before he decides the math works.

edits.before: Through 4-5 your Death Ray poke and cautious farm neutralize his kill threat into a coinflip.
edits.after: Through 4-5 your Hextech Ray poke and cautious farm neutralize his kill threat into a coinflip.

edits.before: At 6 his Shadow Assassin ultimate and wall-hop roams give him the stronger all-in and map pressure.
edits.after: At 6 his Shadow Assault ultimate and wall-hop roams give him the stronger all-in and map pressure.

edits.before: With two-plus items your evolved Death Ray, self-peel and range let you out-fight and out-scale him.
edits.after: With two-plus items your evolved Hextech Ray, self-peel and range let you out-fight and out-scale him.

edits.before: Talon spikes hardest here: at 3 he has Q (Noxian Diplomacy), W (Rake) and the passive bleed to combo most of your HP, and he vaults your minions or the mid walls with E to close instantly. You have Death Ray to poke but no self-peel yet, so respect his all-in every time you step up.
edits.after: Talon spikes hardest here: at 3 he has Q (Noxian Diplomacy), W (Rake) and the passive bleed to combo most of your HP, and he vaults your minions or the mid walls with E to close instantly. You have Hextech Ray to poke but no self-peel yet, so respect his all-in every time you step up.

edits.before: His level 6 Shadow Assassin R plus wall-hopping means a roam-and-return kill threat; you have Chaos Storm at 6 but no reliable escape, so a landed Gravity Field root is your only way to survive his engage.
edits.after: His level 6 Shadow Assault R plus wall-hopping means a roam-and-return kill threat; you have Chaos Storm at 6 but no reliable escape, so a landed Gravity Field stun is your only way to survive his engage.

edits.before: Once you complete Lost Chapter into your first item and boots, you out-range his engage and evolved Death Ray shreds him whenever he walks up for CS.
edits.after: Once you complete Lost Chapter into your first item and boots, you out-range his engage and evolved Hextech Ray shreds him whenever he walks up for CS.

edits.before: After your first item and into two-plus items you take over: evolved Death Ray melts him if he approaches, Chaos Storm plus Gravity Field give you self-peel and zone control, and his assassin burst can no longer one-shot you. Shove waves, control vision and use your range to deny his roams. In fights you sit behind your frontline where he simply can't reach you.
edits.after: After your first item and into two-plus items you take over: evolved Hextech Ray melts him if he approaches, Chaos Storm plus Gravity Field give you self-peel and zone control, and his assassin burst can no longer one-shot you. Shove waves, control vision and use your range to deny his roams. In fights you sit behind your frontline where he simply can't reach you.

notes: Chart: win[] already matched the packet, so all six fixes are side-alone with rewritten whys. spikes[1] also corrected 'Gravity Field root' to 'stun' (Riot text: stun, not root) inside the Shadow Assault rename edit. 'Siphon Power's' suspectName is a false positive (correct possessive). dosFull[2].d's 'fifteen-second invitation' overstates Rake's 9s CD but is inside a whiff-punish line; flagged here rather than churning a borderline field. 'Death Ray' -> 'Hextech Ray' matches the same call in the ryze/taliyah proposals. spikes[2] claims a first-item takeover while win[5] says Talon; left — spike text describes component timing (Lost Chapter) and the chart row describes the completed-item fight, both defensible.
